images.caption: Musiktheater im Revier (MiR), an opera house in Gelsenkirchen, Germany. Designed by the architects group Werner Ruhnau, Harald Deilmann, Ortwin Rave and Max von Hausen. Artwork in the interior of the building includes: a blue relief by Yves Klein and mobiles sculpted by Jean Tinguely. The theatre opened in December of 1959.
images.alt: Musiktheater im Revier (MiR), an opera house in Gelsenkirchen, Germany. Designed by the architects group Werner Ruhnau, Harald Deilmann, Ortwin Rave and Max von Hausen. Artwork in the interior of the building includes: a blue relief by Yves Klein and mobiles sculpted by Jean Tinguely. The theatre opened in December of 1959.
